clauses.clause: Cold load, real level click → playable (loading card closed / Begin ready): **≤ 6.0 s worst of N**, every level, WebGPU + WebGL2, low + high.
clauses.note: Fresh QA production real L1 menu click to Begin-ready: low Metal WebGL2 cold7773.9000ms (>6000ms), loading card shown0.5ms after click, no browser errors. Quiet exclusive admission11:56:51.714Z at load2.4692,busy[]; first receipt11:57:02.699Z precedes observed foreign Vitest start~11:57:21Z. Later matrix timings are excluded after host contention. Separate sampled confirmation cold2222.6000ms/warm2095ms passes; worst-of-N retains the first miss. Repro: npm run build:qa; serve QA preview4836; RELEASE_QUALITY=low RELEASE_SIDES=candidate RELEASE_CANDIDATE_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4836 RELEASE_OUT=test-results/rr-b/G01-repro BROWSER_POOL_JOB_ID=rr-b sh tools/perf/quiet-run.sh node --import tsx/esm tools/qa/release-ab-load.mjs L1 webgl2. Scope: one rejecting cell, not a full backend/tier matrix.
